known_issues: Zoom error persists when zooming to street level — not fixed in Version 35

existing_features.title: Fix the error that occurs when zooming to street level on the community map. Audit and correct tile URL computation, zoom level capping, and Web Mercator math in CustomMapView, useMapTiles, and useMapTransform so that zooming to the maximum supported zoom level (19) works without errors or broken tiles.

projectName: Fix street-level zoom error in CustomMapView
